id: 03_Compressed Gas Cylinders Proper Handling and Storage Equipment Safety
title: 气瓶的储存与搬运
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/03_Compressed Gas Cylinders Proper Handling and Storage Equipment Safety.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/03_Compressed Gas Cylinders Proper Handling and Storage Equipment Safety/src.py

points.K2: 高压气体，危害各不相同
points.K3: 气瓶大小不一，瓶帽有两种
points.K7: 易燃与氧化性气体分开放
points.K13: 不长距离滚动，倒了别去接
points.K15: 车辆运输：直立固定，不进乘客舱
points.K16: 电梯运送：人不同乘，挂牌提醒

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排用链条固定的气瓶旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained to a wall rack and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天讲气瓶怎样储存、怎样搬运。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进气瓶间，看着一排气瓶发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a gas cylinder storage room for the first time and stares at the row of cylinders.
shots.narration: 阿杰要开始用气瓶了，从哪学起？

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前完成空白的在线培训页面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a computer completing an online training course; the screen shows only a gas cylinder icon and a QR code icon.
shots.narration: 先完成学校的气瓶安全培训。

shots.section_title: 高压气体，危害各不相同
shots.scene: 气瓶剖面示意，里面挤满气体分子，外面有压力箭头
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a gas cylinder packed with gas particles and arrows pushing outward on the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶里是高压储存的气体或混合气。
overlay: 高压气体，危害各不相同

shots.section_title: 高压气体，危害各不相同
shots.scene: 四个菱形危险标志排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four dangerous goods diamond labels in a row with simple symbols: a flame, a gas cylinder, a skull, and a flame over a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃、不燃无毒、有毒、氧化性。

shots.section_title: 气瓶大小不一，瓶帽有两种
shots.scene: 高矮粗细不同的几只气瓶并排，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders of different heights and widths stand side by side with blank labels next to the female graduate student in a lab coat.
shots.narration: 气瓶有大有小，形状各不相同。
overlay: 气瓶大小不一，瓶帽有两种

shots.section_title: 气瓶大小不一，瓶帽有两种
shots.scene: 两只瓶顶并排：一只拧着瓶帽，一只带固定护罩
shots.prompt_en: Two cylinder tops side by side: one with a removable screw-on cap and one with a built-in protective collar around the valve. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶帽有可拆卸的，也有固定护罩。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套翻阅一本空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, flips through a blank safety data sheet binder on the bench.
shots.narration: 储存搬运前，先熟悉安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 说明书旁浮现火焰、温度计、分子三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside a blank document, three icons appear: a flame, a thermometer and a molecule. No people.
shots.narration: 弄清它的危害和理化性质。

shots.scene: 着火气瓶图标旁三张小图：杂乱堆放、接口冒汽、扛在肩上
shots.prompt_en: A burning cylinder icon next to three small pictures: cylinders piled in a messy heap, a connector puffing white gas, and a person carrying a cylinder on the shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 事故多来自储存、安装和搬运。

shots.scene: 五个事故原因图标排成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Five icons arranged in a circle around a warning triangle: a messy cylinder pile, a gas puff, a loose connector, a dented cylinder, and a falling cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 还有意外泄漏和气瓶损坏。

shots.scene: 气瓶架上多只气瓶用链条固定，通风口、地面干燥
shots.prompt_en: Several cylinders chained in a storage rack in a cool room with a ventilation grille and a dry floor. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶放在阴凉、干燥、通风的地方。

shots.section_title: 易燃与氧化性气体分开放
shots.scene: 氧化性气瓶和易燃气瓶分在两边，中间一道双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinders standing far apart, one with a flame over circle symbol and one with a flame symbol, with a long double-headed arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃和氧化性气体，至少隔20英尺。
overlay: 易燃与氧化性气体分开放

shots.section_title: 易燃与氧化性气体分开放
shots.scene: 两只气瓶之间一道隔断墙
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinders on either side of a solid partition wall. No people.
shots.narration: 或者用合格的隔断分开。

shots.scene: 气瓶靠墙直立，带子在中部偏上固定，标出瓶肩和中点
shots.prompt_en: Two gas cylinders stand upright against a wall, secured by a strap between the midpoint and the shoulder, with two marker lines. No people.
shots.narration: 直立存放，固定在中点以上、瓶肩以下。

shots.scene: 瓶帽拧好的气瓶打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An upright chained cylinder with its cap screwed on and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶帽也要戴好。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在走廊出口前，旁边是安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a corridor in front of an emergency exit sign and spreads its arms.
shots.narration: 出口和疏散通道，绝不能放气瓶。

shots.scene: 四个打叉图标：水滴、太阳、暖气片、腐蚀瓶
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each crossed out with a red X: a water drop, a bright sun, a heater, and a corrosive liquid bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿、暴晒、受热、盐和腐蚀品旁。

shots.scene: 两个互相排斥的瓶子图标
shots.prompt_en: Two bottle icons pushing away from each other with a lightning spark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能挨着不相容的物质。

shots.scene: 落满灰尘的气瓶旁有日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A dusty gas cylinder in a corner next to a calendar icon with many pages flipped. No people.
shots.narration: 超过一年不用的，不要再存着。

shots.scene: 老周穿实验服，护目镜推在额头上，在气瓶旁戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat, with safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, pulls on gloves beside chained gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 在实验室搬运气瓶，要穿最低防护。

shots.scene: 四个防护图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: safety goggles, a lab coat, gloves and a fully enclosed shoe. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜、实验服、手套、全包鞋。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手按住瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses down on the protective cap of a gas cylinder, checking that it is tight. No people.
shots.narration: 搬运前，确认瓶帽戴上并拧紧。

shots.scene: 气瓶倒地，瓶帽护住瓶阀的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a capped cylinder tipping over, with a shield icon around the cap protecting the valve inside. No people.
shots.narration: 磕碰或倒下时，瓶帽能保护瓶阀。

shots.scene: 手抓瓶帽提气瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand lifting a cylinder by its cap, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能抓着瓶帽提起气瓶。

shots.scene: 在地上拖拽气瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person pictogram dragging a cylinder across the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能在地上拖着走。

shots.section_title: 不长距离滚动，倒了别去接
shots.scene: 用手滚动气瓶走远路的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand rolling a cylinder along a long path, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要用手滚着气瓶走远路。
overlay: 不长距离滚动，倒了别去接

shots.section_title: 不长距离滚动，倒了别去接
shots.scene: 气瓶跌落的示意，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder slipping out of control and falling, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶很难控制，跌落非常危险。

shots.section_title: 不长距离滚动，倒了别去接
shots.scene: 倾倒的气瓶旁，小人后退让开
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a falling cylinder and a person pictogram stepping back out of the way with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶倒下时，不要伸手去接。

shots.scene: 老周在室外装卸平台把气瓶放上推车，扣好链条
shots.prompt_en: On an outdoor loading dock, the older man places a gas cylinder upright on a cylinder hand cart and fastens the chain.
shots.narration: 用合适的气瓶推车，固定好再运。

shots.scene: 老周推着推车走在走廊里
shots.prompt_en: The older man pushes the cylinder cart down a corridor, seen from behind.
shots.narration: 推着推车，稳稳送到实验室。

shots.section_title: 车辆运输：直立固定，不进乘客舱
shots.scene: 货车车厢里直立固定的一排气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A cargo truck with an open cargo area where gas cylinders stand upright, strapped to a rack. No people.
shots.narration: 车辆运输，气瓶要直立固定。
overlay: 车辆运输：直立固定，不进乘客舱

shots.section_title: 车辆运输：直立固定，不进乘客舱
shots.scene: 小轿车座位上的气瓶被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas cylinder on the back seat of a passenger car, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只用学校车辆，不放乘客舱。

shots.section_title: 电梯运送：人不同乘，挂牌提醒
shots.scene: 小研把推车上的气瓶推进电梯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pushes a cart with a chained gas cylinder into an elevator car.
shots.narration: 跨楼层，用电梯或货运升降机。
overlay: 电梯运送：人不同乘，挂牌提醒

shots.section_title: 电梯运送：人不同乘，挂牌提醒
shots.scene: 人和气瓶同在电梯里的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing inside an elevator next to a gas cylinder, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 但人不能和气瓶一起乘。

shots.section_title: 电梯运送：人不同乘，挂牌提醒
shots.scene: 小研在推车上挂一块警示牌后退出电梯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hangs a blank warning tag with a general warning triangle on the cart and steps out of the elevator.
shots.narration: 在气瓶上挂警示牌，提醒别人别进。

shots.section_title: 电梯运送：人不同乘，挂牌提醒
shots.scene: 电梯门关上
shots.prompt_en: The elevator doors slide closed with the cylinder cart alone inside. No people.
shots.narration: 电梯门关上，气瓶单独上楼。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻看一本空白的气瓶安全指南
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank gas cylinder safety guide booklet with a cylinder icon on the cover.
shots.narration: 更多内容，查气瓶安全指南。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question in the lab office.
shots.narration: 有疑问，联系学校安全部门。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现链条、温度计和双向箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a chain, a thermometer and a double-headed arrow.
shots.narration: 阴凉通风，分开存放，直立固定。

shots.scene: 瓶帽、推车、电梯警示牌三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a screwed-on cylinder cap, a cylinder hand cart and an elevator with a warning tag. No people.
shots.narration: 拧紧瓶帽，推车运送，人不同乘。

shots.scene: 欣欣在固定好的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside neatly chained gas cylinders.
shots.narration: 气瓶站得稳，实验才安心，下次见！
